hypothesis: L backbone and B/L concatenations did not improve both development gates. Test whether frozen self-supervised L geometry regularizes the B classifier when used only as a privileged training target.
architecture: Unchanged M5 B320+448 regional attention and 256-dimensional compact disease head. Before hidden dropout, a training-only 64-dimensional decoder predicts both standardized L CLS features (cosine) or their interpatient similarity geometry (Gram MSE). Decoder initialization restores common RNG. Export removes decoder and strictly loads original M5 Model.
teacher_target_policy: No trained teacher classifier. Frozen label-free L CLS per original fit image only; channel mean/std fitted inside each fit, then clip and per-scale unit normalize. Targets detached. Relation objective excludes every pair from same patient. Neither teacher stopping nor outer targets appear in training loss.
training: Each arm 3 formal seeds + original 3 patient folds x3 seeds; original M5 hyperparameters, patient/class weights, task losses, stopping criterion, random streams and data. Train semantic decoder from scratch with student; no warm start.
selection: Require original patient CV Macro-F1 above frozen M5 and validation Macro-F1 no decrease. Freeze any eligible candidate before fresh patient confirmation against M5 and fixed Gaussian; no automatic external evaluation.
external_test_policy: No new external image extraction, no external outcome/prediction access for architecture or parameter selection.
